fredonia-natural-gas-well.description: A bearded man in a cap and worn work coat kneels in a muddy trench, fitting or cutting a hollowed wooden log pipe, with dark liquid seeping around it. Nearby lie more log pipes, shovels, and a black, tar-like substance. Behind him, a plank-built house has a tall pole with an open flame at its top, and a few figures stand by the house under a dark, bare-tree night. The style is a dark oil painting with no visible text, frame, or wounds.

baku-first-mechanical-oil-well.description: A tall timber derrick stands on a dark, oil-stained shore beside a grey sea with two or three distant sailing ships under a stormy dusk sky. Several bearded men in white shirts and dark coats haul on ropes that run up over pulleys to an iron hook and bit. A man in a dark greatcoat and peaked cap gestures beside the rig, and a small fire burns on a hillside at the right edge.

drake-well-titusville.description: A bearded man in a dark frock coat and top hat leans over a wooden barrel while thick black oil pours from a pipe into it. Behind him stand a tall wooden derrick, a small wooden engine house with a tall smokestack, and a few barrels. A figure crouches at left near the pipe. The scene is a dim, dusky forest clearing with smoke in the sky and a warm glow from the shed. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border.

first-oil-pipeline-pithole.description: A painting of a muddy dirt track with a large metal pipeline running diagonally across the foreground. On the left a horse-harnessed wooden wagon carries wooden barrels. At right a steam locomotive pulls a large wooden tank car along a railway, with smoke rising into an overcast sky. Small figures stand near the tracks, with rough wooden shacks and a derrick silhouette in the background and bare trees at the edges. No visible text, no frame.

gluckauf-first-modern-tanker.description: A dark-hulled steamship with a tall mast and a funnel smoking at a night quay. Thick hoses run from the ship's side to the stone dock, where workers in caps stand near tall cylindrical tanks, a brick warehouse, cranes and glowing lamp posts. Painted in an oil style with a stormy sky.

spindletop-gusher.description: A painted scene of a tall wooden oil derrick, a lattice tower, with a thick black column of crude oil gushing skyward from its top and spattering down. Several men in period hats and jackets run and gesture around the base on muddy, oily ground under a grey overcast sky. The landscape is flat and open. No visible text, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge.

persia-oil-discovery-masjed-soleiman.description: A painterly scene of a tall wooden lattice derrick with a black wellhead spewing dark liquid and dripping oil, with smoke rising behind it. Two men stand in the foreground looking up at the well: one bearded, in a dark turban and rough tunic, the other in a pith helmet and khaki shirt. Rocky, dry hills and a dusky sky fill the background. The image is dark and warm-toned, with no visible text, border or frame, and nothing graphic.

standard-oil-breakup.description: A dim, oil-painted courtroom with dark wood panelling, marble columns, and robed judges seated on a raised bench at the back. In the foreground, a long wooden table holds a detailed model of an oil field: wooden derricks, tanks, pipes, small factories and houses on a board, with a few loose pieces scattered at the front. A robed figure sits at the left edge in the foreground, with candles on stands and drapes on tall windows. No visible text, and the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. Era cues look early 20th century: suits, judicial robes, lamps and derricks of that style.

teapot-dome-oil-leases.description: A painted oil-style scene at dusk. Two men in dark overcoats and fedoras stand in sagebrush scrub, one handing a cloth money bag to the other. Behind them a huge teapot-shaped sandstone butte rises from a mesa, and to the right an oil derrick stands on the flat plain under a stormy blue-grey sky. No visible text, no frame, no blood or nudity.

baba-gurgur-gusher-iraq.description: A tall black column of oil or gas shoots up from a wellhead at the top of the frame, with flames flickering at its base. A wooden derrick tower stands in the centre-left on a barren dirt plain. Several robed figures in white headdresses and dark robes walk or run toward the viewer in the lower left, and small ground fires burn among dark rocks. The sky is grey and smoky, and the whole thing is in a loose, thick-brushed oil-painting style with no visible text or frame.

east-texas-oil-field-discovery.description: A painting of a tall, weathered wooden derrick in a pine-edged clearing, with black crude gushing up from its top into a stormy grey sky. Around its base, a crowd of men in work clothes, overalls and wide-brimmed hats raise their arms and cheer in muddy ground. A rustic wooden barn sits at the right edge under the trees.

bahrain-first-gulf-oil-strike.description: An oil-painting style scene of a tall black steel derrick rising over a flat, dusty desert beside a flat-topped rocky hill, with smoke drifting from machinery. In the foreground, two men in khaki work clothes and a hat bend over a wellhead spilling black crude, surrounded by about a dozen men in white and grey robes and headcloths, some gesturing. Pumping gear, tanks and a small stack sit on the right.

first-offshore-well-out-of-sight-of-land.description: A steel lattice drilling derrick stands on a legged platform in rough, dark open sea under a heavy grey storm sky, with no land visible on the horizon. A rust-streaked mid-century cargo ship with masts and cranes lies alongside the platform, linked by a gangway. Small figures are visible on the decks, and the scene is painted in a moody oil style.

iran-nationalizes-oil-industry.description: A painted industrial scene: a refinery of tall distillation towers, pipes and round storage tanks along a shore, with smoke rising from stacks. On the left a crowd of men in flat caps and suits presses against iron gates, several raising fists. On the right, men in long overcoats and fedoras walk along the waterfront carrying briefcases and suitcases. No visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.
